summary: Hyundai ABS Funding, LLC, as depositor, and Hyundai Auto Receivables Trust 2026-C filed an 8-K reporting an Underwriting Agreement dated September 15, 2026 with J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, as representative of the underwriters, for the sale of seven classes of asset-backed notes with an aggregate principal balance of $2,066,160,000. Closing is expected on or about September 23, 2026. The filing also covers the receivables purchase agreement with Hyundai Capital America, the amended and restated trust agreement with U.S. Bank Trust, the sale and servicing agreement with Citibank, and the indenture. This is a routine auto-loan ABS issuance, not a special situation.
